title: 新游速览：EA FC Mobile 27、Aniimo、Bloons、Kingdom Rush、Epic Mickey、Moco 等
content:
New game digest: EA FC Mobile 27, Aniimo, Bloons, Kingdom Rush, Epic Mickey, Moco and more – Mobilegamer.biz
Skip to content
Here every Friday you’ll find the latest global releases, game dates, new soft launches and everything in between.
This column is sponsored by
Kohort
.
Plug in your MMP and
Ktrl will tell you what to scale by this afternoon
. 20-minute setup, no engineering required.
EA Sports FC Mobile 27 (EA)
EA has just unveiled its new annual update for FC Mobile 27. The new season introduces a new PvE mode, better tactical control, and a “refreshed visual experience,” and launches alongside a new month-long community event that brings back fan-favourite features. It’s out now globally for both Android and iOS devices.
Aniimo (Pawprint Studio)
The free-to-play creature-catching open-world RPG, backed by FunPlus, has launched globally on iOS and Android following its PC, PS5 and Xbox debut last week. It’s also being featured by Apple in an App Store
story
.
Bloons Blitz (Ninja Kiwi)
This Bloons-themed bullet heaven game, in the style of Vampire Survivors, is going global soon on iOS and Android following a Philippines-only soft launch in May. Pre-registration is now open
Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis (Ironhide Game Studio)
The tower defense series’ sixth mainline entry, Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis is out now worldwide on Steam, the App Store and Google Play.
Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed (THQ Nordic Mobile)
Disney’s revived Mickey Mouse platformer, which first arrived on the Wii back in 2010, is out now on iOS and Android at around $16.
Mo.co (Supercell)
As reported yesterday,
Supercell is putting Mo.co back into beta
to find a way forward with its underperforming monster hunting game.
That means the game will be in “low maintenance” mode for now, but Supercell says that it will be able to iterate and experiment with the game more quickly long-term.
Horizon Create (Meta)
As reported earlier, Meta says its new game creation and publishing app
Horizon Create
will enable players to make a game with a prompt and then publish straight to Instagram, Facebook and its Horizon ecosystems.
People Tower (Popcore)
People Tower is a sort-and-stack hybridcasual puzzle game from Popcore where players match and stack characters by colour as they race down the path. It’s currently in early testing on iOS, says AppMagic.
Sanrio Kawaii Me Live (Sanrio Games)
This is Sanrio’s first mobile title, a free-to-play dance and rhythm game starring Hello Kitty, Cinnamoroll, My Melody and more. Sanrio Kawaii Me Live launches globally on iOS and Android in January 2027. Pre-registration is open now.
Athelan Battlegrounds (Athelan)
Turn-based tactical PvP game Athelan Battlegrounds will launch on PC and Google Play on November 25. It is developed by a two-person team based in Canada.
Zooyale (Playfinity Games)
A free top-down battle royale with mid-match animal/mutant transformations, Zooyale supports up to 50 player. It’s out now on iOS and Android worldwide.
